headline: The run timed out: the pill bottle sat 29 cm out, beyond the arm's 25 cm reach, so 4 grasps closed on air.

claims.text: The tray holds nothing; the pill bottle is not in it.
The 18 s deadline passed at 18.04 s and the task was abandoned.
The gripper closed on nothing 4 times (first at 5.96 s).
Each time, the fingers closed 4.3 to 4.5 cm short of the pill bottle.
The pill bottle sat 29.3 cm from the base axis; the arm reaches 24.8 cm at that height. The fingertip never got closer than 3.8 cm.
The arm hit something. Refuted: no joint ever stalled against its command; the largest tracking error was 2.0 deg on the wrist_flex.
The arm moved too slowly to finish in time. Refuted: the arm ran at speed_scale 1.0: full speed.
The target moved, so each grasp arrived where it used to be. Refuted: the pill bottle stayed put (moved 0.6 cm).
Check reach before the first attempt and ask for the object to be moved instead of regrasping until the deadline.

hypotheses.test: Where the camera last saw every object labelled as the target, and whether that is inside the destination zone.
hypotheses.refute_if: No object labelled as the target is inside the destination zone in the last camera frame.
hypotheses.summary: The tray holds nothing; the pill bottle is not in it.
hypotheses.why: decides whether there is a failure to explain

hypotheses.statement: The run ran out of time.
hypotheses.test: Whether the controller hit the goal's deadline before finishing.
hypotheses.refute_if: The run ended before the deadline with no deadline event.
hypotheses.summary: The 18 s deadline passed at 18.04 s and the task was abandoned.

runs.summary: The run ended at 17.16 s, inside its 25 s deadline.

hypotheses.test: Whether a joint stalled (measured speed near zero) while its command kept moving, building tracking error, and whether its motor current rose with it. Lag at high speed builds error too, but the joint keeps moving.
hypotheses.refute_if: No joint stalls with more than 2.5 deg of tracking error while its command is moving.
hypotheses.summary: No joint ever stalled against its command; the largest tracking error was 2.0 deg on the wrist_flex.

hypotheses.statement: The object slipped out of the gripper.
hypotheses.test: After the grasp, whether the fingers (still commanded closed) closed past the object, and whether the object's camera track fell away from the fingertip.
hypotheses.refute_if: The gripper opening stays at the object's width from the grasp until the gripper is commanded open.
hypotheses.summary: The gripper never held anything, so nothing could slip.

hypotheses.statement: The arm moved a different object than the goal named.
hypotheses.test: Which camera track was in the fingers at the grasp, and what perception called it at close range.
hypotheses.refute_if: The grasped track's confident label is the goal's target.

hypotheses.test: Whether a grasp closed the fingers fully (below 3 deg) right after reaching for the object.
hypotheses.refute_if: Every grasp stopped on an object (opening above 3 deg).
hypotheses.summary: The gripper closed on nothing 4 times (first at 5.96 s).

runs.summary: Every grasp stopped on an object.

hypotheses.statement: The target was out of the arm's reach.
hypotheses.test: The target's distance from the base axis, from its camera track, against the arm's maximum reach at that height (link lengths in the log).
hypotheses.summary: The pill bottle sat 29.3 cm from the base axis; the arm reaches 24.8 cm at that height. The fingertip never got closer than 3.8 cm.

runs.summary: The target at 11.3 cm is inside the 24.1 cm reach.

hypotheses.statement: The arm moved too slowly to finish in time.
hypotheses.test: config.speed_scale, which scales every joint's speed cap.
hypotheses.summary: The arm ran at speed_scale 1.0: full speed.

hypotheses.statement: The target moved, so each grasp arrived where it used to be.
hypotheses.test: How far the target's camera track moved over the run.
hypotheses.refute_if: The target moved less than 1.5 cm.
hypotheses.summary: The pill bottle stayed put (moved 0.6 cm).

hypotheses.statement: The fingers closed away from the object.
hypotheses.test: Horizontal distance from the fingertip to the target's camera track each time the gripper closed on nothing.
hypotheses.refute_if: The fingertip was within 2 cm of the target at every empty close.
hypotheses.summary: Each time, the fingers closed 4.3 to 4.5 cm short of the pill bottle.
